title.lfm: 📌 New sign-up for your Static poster
title.fc: 📌 New sign-up for your Free Company

body.lfs: **{name}** ({mention}) sent you a recruitment offer for your poster **{title}**.
body.fc: **{name}** ({mention}) wants to join your Free Company (poster **{title}**).
body.lffc: **{name}** ({mention}) invited you to their Free Company (your poster **{title}**).

cardFailed: Their IGN card could not be made right now.

skip.title: ⚠️ Pingway skipped a Boards channel post
skip.body: Pingway could not post about your poster **{title}** in your server channel: {reason}
skip.fix: You can change it in the poster’s Notifications on pingway.app (Dashboard → Boards). The DM to you was sent as usual.
skip.noGuild: Pingway is not in that server any more.
skip.notAdmin: you are no longer the owner or an admin of that server.
skip.noPerms: Pingway needs View Channel, Send Messages, Embed Links and Attach Files in that channel.
skip.noRole: the role to ping is gone.
skip.cantMention: Pingway may not ping that role (make the role mentionable, or give Pingway the Mention @everyone permission).

test.dmBody: This is a test. Pingway can DM you: sign-ups, recruitment offers and invites for your posters arrive here.
test.channelOk: The test was also posted in {channel}.
test.channelPost: 🔔 Pingway Boards test: sign-ups for **{name}**’s posters will be posted in this channel.

report.title: ⚑ Your poster was reported
report.body: Someone reported your poster **{title}**. Reason: {reason}. Reports so far: {count}.
report.hidden: It is now hidden from the boards until the Pingway team checks it.
report.rule: A poster hides itself after 3 reports.

expiry.body: Your poster **{title}** expires on {time}. Bump it in the Boards tab to keep it up for 30 more days: {url}
expiry.body0: Your poster **{title}** is off the boards now. Everything is kept: repost it in the Boards tab: {url}
